scope: Isolated byte-array request-body hypothesis test; the candidate is not integrated
candidate: A separate worktree UTF-8 encodes bridge JSON payloads of at least 65536 characters into Uint8Array request bodies instead of wrapping them in Blobs. Smaller payloads remain strings.

synthetic.method: One headless Chromium run sent 1835 local synthetic JSON requests, totaling 641448830 bytes; no application artifact data was used.
synthetic.limitation: The synthetic result is not application or MCP acceptance. Its first attempt was rejected before launch because disk headroom was below the guard.

candidateValidation.fullSizeReplay: failed: after a full download with matching stream and file hashes, the project opened but the browser disconnected before geometry verification; post-reopen history was not reached.

nearDownloadSample.unit: private committed bytes in one nearby two-second process sample
nearDownloadSample.limitation: The sample does not identify specific allocations or establish causality.

conclusion: The synthetic improvement did not carry over to a passing real replay. Keep the existing bridge behavior and continue investigating the resource limit.
